column1: # Words of Wingman itself and of everyday speech that voices get wrong, for no
# German voices read the English words the German way: "on-lie-ne" and a
# short "a" in "Wingman". These spell the English sound (2026-10-19).
# "onlain" came out "onläihn" with the German Pocket TTS model (2026-10-21).
